items.text: BRIEF — 70s launch film for Evolv28, 1920×1080 @ 30. One message: your alarm system is ancient; Evolv28 switches it off at the source. Arc: CALM → CHAOS → CAUSE → CALM, BY DESIGN.

THE PRODUCT — matte graphite collar, thin teal light line. Every gen recipe stages THIS design.
WORDMARK — white on navy, coral smile. Real asset lands in the end card; never redrawn.

PALETTE (site tokens) — navy #0D1B2A · navy-mid #122436 · teal #00B4B4 · offwhite #F5F2EE · amber #F59E0B · coral #EE6C4D. Savannah scenes run warm gold; city runs cold cyan; product scenes own the navy + teal.

items.text: TONE — calm is the product. Nobody performs wellness at the camera.

VOICE — one narrator, woman mid-40s, low and warm, close-mic, unhurried, quietly wry. Documentary calm, never salesy. Six independent ElevenLabs Multilingual v2 reads via fal, shared Aria preset — the recipe prompt is the spoken line, sized ~1.5s under its slot so no read clips.

SOUND — Serengeti bed under the savannah (asset://music-serengeti, ducked at 0.28 under VO, cut dead at the city smash) → notification SFX piling with the storm overlay → near-silence on the button press → soft low alpha hum to the end card (TODO).
TYPE — site sets Fraunces (display serif) + Inter (sans). Comps approximate with Georgia + system sans until licensed woff2s land in public/fonts. Chips and timecodes: ui-monospace.
STRUCTURE — 1 origin (10s) · 2 overload (12s) · 3 same alarm (12s) · 4 calm, engineered (15s) · 5 routine (8s) · 6 real people (8s) · 7 get yours (5s).
VALERIE — “My sleep increased by more than two hours a night.”
FREDRIK — “Getting my sleep back gave me my day back.”

CLAIMS DISCIPLINE — trial numbers verbatim from the site (+45 min sleep, HRV up, placebo-controlled). Wellness framing, no medical promises. Testimonials stay REAL: stills + verbatim quotes, never synthesized faces or voices.
REFERENCE RULE — this board organizes research. Generation recipes point to the original asset:// media, never to this moodboard composition.
